_comment: KSVs for the closed-loop NeTV2<->RPi HDCP test rig. KSVs are exchanged in the clear over the HDMI DDC and are safe to commit. The device key sets (source_keys.bin, sink_keys.bin) and the agreed shared secret Km are NOT stored here and must never be committed; they live only in ~/netv2-hdcp-handoff/keys/ on the lab machines. Keys come from one symmetric master matrix (hdcp/keygen.py); no real DCP device keys or master key are used.
sink: NeTV2 HDCP receiver on hdmi_in0 (Bksv = ksv_sink)
